items.docs: Compares 2+ providers — composite/band, per-facet leaders, and an artifact-coverage matrix. Pro tier.

info.name: Artifact + score gap analysis for a provider or stack (Pro).

params.name: providers
params.description: Comma-separated provider slugs (1+). Multiple = treat as a stack.

params.name: min_share
params.description: Peer-share threshold for a gap (0–1, default 0.25).

items.docs: For each provider — the high-value artifacts it lacks, what its peers commonly publish but it lacks, and its score vs the peer median — plus stack-level gaps across the set. Pro tier.

info.name: What changed in the catalog since a date (Pro).

items.docs: Providers added/updated since a date, plus rating movement (up/down) from the latest scoring build. Pro tier.

info.name: Design a recommended API stack per capability.

params.name: capabilities
params.description: Comma-separated capabilities the stack needs, e.g. `payments,email,identity,observability`.

params.name: region
params.description: Optional region slug to prefer, e.g. `europe`.

items.docs: Decompose a domain into capabilities, then get the best-rated catalog provider per capability assembled into a stack. FREE returns a preview (top pick per capability); PRO returns alternatives, per-pick artifact gaps, and an exportable APIs.json + Arazzo hint.

info.name: Artifact gaps across a whole industry.

params.name: min_share
params.description: Coverage threshold below which a type counts as an industry gap (0–1, default 0.5).

items.docs: For an industry vertical, reports which valuable artifact types (MCP, Arazzo, Rules, Skills…) most member providers lack — where the vertical is under-served.

info.name: Export a designed stack as APIs.json.

params.name: capabilities
params.description: Comma-separated capabilities the stack needs, e.g. `payments,email,identity`.

items.docs: Given a set of capabilities, returns the designed stack as an adoptable APIs.json document (with an Arazzo hint) the team can commit.
